author: Retro Game Corps
description:
Here is how to set up a simple home console system running SteamOS. It'll be a great fit for lightweight PC games and retro emulation.

Official SteamOS image: https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/65B4-2AA3-5F37-4227
RetroDeck: https://retrodeck.net/
RetroDeck wiki: https://retrodeck.readthedocs.io/en/latest/
Steam Machine emulation guide (for EmuDeck): https://youtu.be/ucqx9P29CXE
8BitDo controller I used: https://link.amazon/B0cInsmLR

AceMagic Retro X3 mini PC: https://acemagic.com/products/x5-mini-pc?variant=51285046296882
Also on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/ACEMAGIC-X3-Windows-PCIe4-0-Business/dp/B0GJ4SHYNT

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer for the purpose of this guide.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this video ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.

Check out my weekly newsletter: http://news.retrogamecorps.com/

title: How to Make an Indie and Retro Game Console
